Approver: Kareem Ibrahim. Escalation: Hatem Ashour. CC reseller@foodics.com on every email.
Iisal and InvoiceQ are licensed per account, not per branch.
For Deliverect, UrbanPiper, Grubtech, FeedUs and wi-Q, the partner submission form isn't used for KSA approvals. Partnerships handles KSA.
terms: Discounts apply to new acquisitions only (merchant signed within 30 days of the invoice date).
A discount is valid for one year. On renewal the merchant pays list price; no new discount.
Expansions do not inherit a discount; each is evaluated on its own.
Downgrade, refund (partial or total) and cancellation only within 30 days of the invoice date. The invoice date governs, not the service start date.
A service that isn't live yet gives no refund right. The remedy is a billing adjustment (dates shift).
Compensation is never cash: it's extended duration on the same service, with documented evidence.
If the partner deactivates the service, the merchant's obligations to Foodics don't change.
Deals outside KSA, Kuwait, UAE, Jordan and Egypt are sold in USD.
Non-renewal must be reported to Partnerships before the renewal date.
